lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Good Samaritan Law & Responsibilities at Crash Scenes
prompt: If you strike an unattended parked vehicle and cannot find the owner, what does Texas law require?

options.text: Attach a secure, plainly visible written note giving your name, address, and insurer
Leave the scene immediately if vehicle damage is estimated under $5,000
Wait for twenty-four hours next to the struck vehicle until the owner returns
Sound your vehicle horn repeatedly until surrounding neighborhood residents exit
